description: This file contains test cases for functions resolving daemon install plans, gateway dev mode detection, and node binary directory resolution, utilizing imports from a shared module and testing with 'vitest'.

methods.name: resolveDaemonInstallRuntimeInputs
methods.description: Resolves the runtime inputs for daemon installation, allowing overrides for devMode and nodePath.

methods.name: resolveDaemonNodeBinDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path of the Node.js binary.

methods.name: resolveGatewayDevMode
methods.description: Detects whether the gateway is running in development mode based on the script path.
